title: `struct.unpack('u', ...)` passes an unvalidated 4-byte codepoint to `rutf8.unichr_as_utf8`
cpython_behavior: the 'u' format was removed in 3.9; struct.error
prior_art: Seeded in pypy-review-toolkit's catalog as PYPY-FUZZ-002. The static catalog's PYPYR-0004 notes this as the same shape with the range check ABSENT, where PYPYR-0004 has the range check present and the surrogate clause absent.
leak_signature: SystemError: unexpected internal exception (please report a bug): <OutOfRange object ...>
notes: The 'u' unpack format reads four bytes and hands them to `rutf8.unichr_as_utf8` as a codepoint with no range check at all, so any four bytes decoding above U+10FFFF raise RPython's `OutOfRange`, which nothing in the struct module catches. One line, no state, no timing.
